text:
maria: Quick heads-up — seeing a QoS drift on vector/rerank endpoints after the accelerator selection change deployed last night. p95 up ~22% on /v1/vec/score at peak. :thinking_face:

jason: ugh, when did that deploy go out? any specific region or model?

maria: rolled at 02:12 UTC, global but spikes concentrated in us-west. Affected model family: vec-small-quant. QPS steady, so looks like per-request latency increase rather than throughput.

tariq: can you paste the token-level breakdown from profiler? curious if KV lookup or attention hot path changed.

maria: here's the recent perf snapshot (sampled trace):
```
p50_total_ms=28.4 p95_total_ms=123.7
- token_parse_ms: 1.1
- kv_lookup_ms: 3.7 (hit rate 68%)
- attention_ms: 45.3
- softmax_ms: 8.9
- kernel_launch_ms: 12.4 (increased after accel switch)
- postproc_ms: 2.0
```

sylvia: attention_ms jump is notable. Could be a different kernel path chosen for the new accel that doesn't handle 128-dim vectors as well. Also see more small-batch runs in the histogram.

jason: promql slice for the p95 by route I used: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/vec/score"}[5m])) by (le, route))`

maria: adding batch-size distribution query we discussed: `sum by(le) (rate(batch_size_bucket{endpoint="vec-score"}[5m]))` — current median batch_size dropped from 8 -> 4 after the change.

tariq: lower batch sizes would absolutely raise per-token costs and kernel launches. suspect routing policy change picked a lower-latency accelerator that doesn't batch well.

sylvia: can we get a flamegraph from the C++ runtime? `./profiler --sample --flame --pid=$PID > /tmp/flame.svg` then upload to the perf board.

maria: uploaded flame.svg to the dashboard (link in ops console). flame shows extra time in `kernel_dispatch` and `cuda_sync` around the softmax subtree.

infra-bot: deploy 1767450100 (accel-select) finished: canary passed (3/3), rollout started.

jason: action items: 1) revert accel-select rollout to canary until we understand batch behavior (tariq), 2) add a per-route batch_size histogram + token-latency breakdown on the vec-score dashboard (sylvia), 3) run a synthetic with pinned batch sizes 4/8/16 to reproduce delta (maria).

tariq: starting rollback now, will comment here when canary is back.

maria: meanwhile i'll add a short-lived alert: if p95_route_vec_score > 100ms for 5m then page and annotate with accel-select tag.

infra-bot: rollback initiated for deploy 1767450100. Estimated finish ~2m.

maria: good catch everyone. let's sync in 30m after synthetic runs. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollback completed for 1767450100, traffic restored to previous accelerators.

maria: early numbers post-rollback: p95 down to 98ms (was 123ms). Still slightly above baseline; will dig into small-batch kernel choice and KV hit improvements.

sylvia: I'll add the dashboard panels now and push a lightweight perf test to the nightly suite.

jason: leaving notes for release: `accel-select` needs a canary config that preserves batching characteristics or a heuristic to prefer kernels optimized for 128-dim vectors.

maria: thanks — tagging this thread in the release notes and perf follow-up doc.
